verdicts.reason: I can't see a real difference between the two. Both enlarge the maroon panel cleanly and keep the type hierarchy and brand, but they share the same flaws. The bottom slash and circle sit about 115px below the panel's bottom edge, so they no longer frame its corners the way the top X and slash do. The panel also has a large empty gap between the rule and 'Join WADE team', and that line now sits on top of the clasped hands at the bottom left. The only change is that the circle sits a few pixels differently in B, which doesn't affect quality.
